mechanism_claims.claim_text: Five Ciona LCAMP candidates have direct in vitro antimicrobial activity evidence in the paper, recorded as MIC values against bacterial and fungal strains.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Activity values support antimicrobial phenotype; they do not by themselves prove membrane-disruption mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Salt-resistance evidence is reported for a subset of the peptides under elevated NaCl in the E. coli assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level values beyond the caption/main text were not locally table-extracted; final curation preserves the qualitative salt-resistance claim only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The proposed membrane-interface/hydrophobic-interaction explanation is computational and interpretive, not a direct membrane permeabilization assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane leakage, depolarization, microscopy, or lipid-binding experiment was recovered in local XML/PDF materials.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LPS inducibility/NF-kB-site evidence is host immune regulation context, not an antimicrobial mechanism of action.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Ciona LCAMP genes with promoter or expression evidence
mechanism_claims.limitations: Regulation evidence should not be promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism.
